text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The first crown of three.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf takes a second to<n>savor the
moment, then raises a<n>finger high for all to see.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The loudest cheer of the day<n>resounds in my
ears—a fitting reaction<n>to the start of a new legend.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I did it, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Congrats! Only two more to go!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha... I see you're already looking<n>ahead.
choice_data_list: We'll take the Japanese Derby by storm.
We'll take the Japanese Derby by storm.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Indeed we will!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so we set our sights on our next<n>goal: the
Japanese Derby. But at that<n>moment...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Come in.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Good afternoon, President.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text: Sorry to bother you...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, you two. Right on time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I may ask, what did you think of my
performance?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Feel free to be as frank as you wish.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text:
You were... unstoppable. Every bit the<n>racer I
thought you were...

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text:
Every bit the racer who inspired me<n>to join the
council. You were so<n>strong, I don't know how
anyone<n>else could touch you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your candor. And let me<n>swear to you
here and now...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I will become stronger still. Strong<n>enough for you to
rely on without<n>hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text: President?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for not seeing your<n>troubles sooner. A
sign that I must<n>pay closer attention to those around
me, no doubt.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you want to become stronger, I will<n>happily guide
you. I don't want you to<n>suffer in silence.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text: B-but you're so busy! I couldn't<n>possibly...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's no burden at all. I would be<n>honored to help you
flourish.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So I ask you to give me one more<n>chance...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And trust that I am strong enough to<n>carry you.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text:
Why are you being so kind to... to a<n>waste of space
like me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Because you are the purest<n>incarnation of my
dream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have charged myself with building a<n>world where
all Umamusume can live<n>in bliss.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And you joined the student council in<n>the hopes of
growing as a person.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I will not watch you give in before you<n>realize your
dream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Please, don't call yourself a waste of<n>space. If you
are struggling to find<n>your way, I will help you find it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you look up to me as much as you<n>say, can you
trust me to lead you in<n>the right direction?

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text: President...

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry I've been acting so scared.I... Sniff... I'll follow you wherever youlead me...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, don't cry. I'm delighted to<n>see you've
found your resolve.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the issue at hand has<n>been resolved.
Rudolf has a knack for<n>leading through strength—a
tactic<n>befitting an Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But such strength requires the<n>determination to
carry an enormous<n>amount of responsibility on her
shoulders. And in that sense, her<n>approach is...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ridiculous.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove watches from a distance,<n>a hint of
frustration in her eyes.
